cards.claim: The Elks organization was founded in 1878.

source_segments.text: At the 1885 Grand Lodge it was reported that the EMBA was prosperous, but its finances were carelessly managed.
The Association was disbanded after the 1907 Grand Lodge passed a resolution banning mutual or insurance features, as well as degrees and auxiliaries.

The first chapter was organized in February 1922 by San Francisco Lodge #3.
